title: Remove dead runtime decomposition (AGENT.Runtime stubs + DI)
description: P0 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-RT-006, council-upgraded): The Sprint 37+ runtime decomposition (6 interfaces + 6 stub implementations + AgentRuntime record + DI registrations) is completely unused by AgentBackgroundService. ABS receives all dependencies directly. Delete: AgentRuntime record, IRecoveryManager/IPlanningManager/IExecutionManager interfaces + stubs, and their DI registrations. Consolidate to only IIrentManager/IDashboardPublisher/IStateManager which have real value. This removes 12+ findings in one commit.
